notes.title: Start your engines... Antigraviator is now available on PS4!
notes.content:
Are you ready to go faster than light? We've been working a long time to bring Antigraviator to console and today we are thrilled to announce that Antigraviator is out for PlayStation 4!

https://youtu.be/VqvJyg0ae2A

[h1]Key Features[/h1]
🏎️ Race in a single-player campaign or multiplayer mode, supporting split-screen for up to two players. 

🏁Challenge your friends under extreme conditions in local and online multiplayer and launch yourself to the top of the worldwide leaderboard.

😈Sabotage your opponents by using traps to destroy the arena, power-ups, and boosts to gain advantage. In a zero-gravity world, it’s up to you to bring your enemies down!

🔥Customize your Grav from a huge variety of skins and upgrades. New customization options will be unlocked as you progress in the game to help you strategically tailor the ultimate vehicle.

We really hope you will enjoy the experience on PlayStation 4! 

Cybernetic Walrus Team

notes.title: Antigraviator Update 1.1 includes new game mode, custom key bindings and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31389425/a748cf113a24413e76c444069dbde934fdb77225.jpg[/img]

We're excited to share that the first major Antigraviator update is now available. Update 1.1 comes with a myriad of new options and a brand new game mode: Pure. Pure mode focusses solely on speed and momentum. There are no traps or pickups to collect. Instead, you generate boost automatically, adding a completely new sensation to the blazingly fast racing experience. The campaigns have also been updated to include Pure mode.

Pure mode and other new options, such as custom key bindings and map-specific leaderboards, were made based on the community's feedback. We have a lot in store for Antigraviator, so keep sharing your thoughts and we'll keep listening. See you out there on the tracks!

Check out the full changelog below, or in the official forum thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/621020/discussions/0/1760230157500515373/

- KevWatch
[list]
[*]Added Pure Mode, which removes traps and pickups from a race. You gain pickups every few seconds so you can still boost. Play Pure Mode races in quickplay and in the main campaigns
[*]Added custom key binds. It's now possible to customise the key binds on your keyboard and controller any way you like! 
[*]Added Multiple camera views. You can now switch between two camera views, the regular cam and a cam that is a bit further away so you see more of the track. A bumper cam is coming very soon!
[*]Added more Leaderboards. Every track now has its own leaderboard for every mode
[*]Added support for the Trustmaster Hotas X
[*]Multiplayer now gives double the number of credits and divides them among all players instead of just the top players
[*]The bug where the game would crash during scene loading seems to be squashed after we updated the Unity player. None of our machines are affected by the bug while running the 1.1 version of the game, and none of our trusted and appreciated testers experience these crashes anymore. However, if you still experience these issues, please let us know on the forum.
[*]We made some improvements to increase performance on some machines.
[*]You can now enable "realtime vehicle reflections" in the options menu. This is only for very high-end machines as this is very resource expensive!
[*]Other smaller bugs have been addressed
[*]Changed the description of the Rocket-powered Rookie achievement. This achievement is rewarded when you complete the rookie league, not the first league.
[/list]
